main:1.page: The Pillar of Autumn (Halo: Reach level)/Walkthrough
main:1.text: This is a walkthrough for the Halo: Reach level The Pillar of Autumn. It is written for play at the Legendary difficulty, but contains notes for lower difficulties. This is the ninth level of Halo: Reach. For this mission you are joined by Emile-A239. Your Mission is to deliver Cortana to Captain Jacob Keyes and the UNSC Pillar of Autumn.
